title: Canon 7: attributes govern all theology — Cap. 7 close
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): 7. Ye attributes belonging toward GOD universal theology divide. For in all theological comments, disputations, plus sermons regard unto ye attributes belonging toward God is to be had, lest anything contrary unto them be established. And in ye whole Christian life these attributes as a cynosure are, that God we may revere plus imitate, plus solid consolation perceive.
pass_b_english: 7. The attributes of GOD divide universal theology. For in all theological comments, disputations, and sermons regard is to be had to the attributes of God, lest anything contrary to them be established. And in the whole Christian life these attributes are as a cynosure, that we may revere and imitate God, and perceive solid consolation.
source_text: 7. Attributa DEI dividunt universam theologiam. Nam in omnibus commentationibus, disputationibus, concionibusque theologicis respiciendum est ad attributa Dei, ne quid statuatur iis contrarium. Et in universa Christiana vita pro cynosura sunt haec attributa, ut Deum revereamur & imitemur, solidumque percipiamus solatium.
